coding-tool:
For Claude Code, run:

claude mcp add --transport http premagentic {address}/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer {token}"

Any other tool that takes an HTTP MCP server with a header connects the same way: the server URL is {address}/mcp and the header is Authorization: Bearer {token}.
other:
Server URL: {address}/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless
Header on every request: Authorization: Bearer {token}

Two tools, both read-only: search_knowledge and get_document_section.
